answer: LIST round(THE COUNT OF Card [has CardIsStorySpotlight: 1] [is of ForeignData has ForeignDataLanguage: 'French'] * 100.0 / THE COUNT OF Card [has CardIsStorySpotlight: 1], 2)
LIST u FROM Card [has CardDuelDeck: 'a'] has CardUuid u
note: id taken as CardUuid per the schema's Identification section

answer: LIST round(THE COUNT OF Card [has CardSetCode: 'CSP'] [has CardKingdomId] [has CardKingdomFoilId] * 100.0 / THE COUNT OF Card [has CardSetCode: 'CSP'], 2)
note: Coldsnap = set code CSP only (not Theme Decks or Promos)

answer: THE DISTINCT COUNT OF n IN Card [has CardIsPromo: 1] [has CardLeadershipSkills ls] [has CardTypes t] has CardName n WHERE contains(ls,'brawl'': True') AND contains(t,'Creature')

THE MAXIMUM v IN (Card [has CardName: 'Tarmogoyf'] has CardFrameVersion y WHERE y <> 'future' AND ALSO castInteger(y) AS v) - THE MINIMUM w IN (Card [has CardName: 'Tarmogoyf'] has CardFrameVersion z WHERE z <> 'future' AND ALSO castInteger(z) AS w)
note: 'future' frame excluded as not a year

answer: LIST y, c FROM Card has CardFrameVersion y AND ALSO THE COUNT OF y GROUPED BY y AS c WHERE y = 'future'
note: newest frame version among cost-0 cards is 'future' (checked separately); its count is 93

answer: LIST n, p FROM Set has SetCode c AND ALSO has SetName n AND ALSO round((THE COUNT OF Card [has CardSetCode: !c] [has CardManaCost] [has CardConvertedManaCost m] WHERE m <= 3) * 100.0 / (THE COUNT OF Card [has CardSetCode: !c]), 2) AS p WHERE c = 'USG' OR c = 'TSR'
note: sets chosen by separate queries: USG (earliest Abyssal Horror set), TSR (latest)

answer: LIST n FROM DISTINCT Card [has CardSetCode: 'DKA'] [has CardKeywords k] has CardName n AND ALSO has CardConvertedManaCost m WHERE contains(concat(',',k,','),',Flash,') AND m = THE MAXIMUM v IN Card [has CardSetCode: 'DKA'] [has CardKeywords k2] has CardConvertedManaCost v WHERE contains(concat(',',k2,','),',Flash,') ORDERED WITH n ASCENDING
note: exact keyword match, since contains('Flash') also matches Flashback

answer: LIST n, k, c FROM Set s has SetName n AND ALSO has SetReleaseDate d AND ALSO OPTIONALLY has SetKeyruneCode k AND ALSO (THE DISTINCT COUNT OF l IN SetTranslation [has Set: !s] has SetTranslationLanguage l) AS c WHERE year(d) = 2020
note: sets with no translations kept with 0

answer: (THE SUM OF p IN (Set s has SetCode c AND ALSO has SetReleaseDate d AND ALSO (THE COUNT OF Card [has CardSetCode: !c]) AS p WHERE year(d) = 2017 AND SOME SetTranslation [has Set: !s])) + (THE SUM OF p2 IN (Set has SetCode c2 AND ALSO has SetParentCode pc AND ALSO (THE COUNT OF Card [has CardSetCode: !c2]) AS p2 WHERE SOME Set ps [has SetCode: !pc] [has SetReleaseDate d2] [is of SetTranslation] WHERE year(d2) = 2017))
note: counts cards of qualifying 2017 sets plus cards of their child sets (parentCode); own sets alone give 808

answer: LIST t, c FROM DISTINCT Set s has SetType t AND ALSO (THE COUNT OF Set [has SetType: !t] [is of SetTranslation has SetTranslationLanguage: 'Japanese']) AS c ORDERED WITH t ASCENDING

THE SUM OF n IN (Set has SetCode c AND ALSO has SetReleaseDate d AND ALSO (THE COUNT OF Card [has CardSetCode: !c] [has CardTypes ty] [has CardPower p] [has CardToughness th] WHERE contains(ty, 'Creature') AND NOT contains(p, '*') AND NOT contains(th, '*') AND castNumber(p) > castNumber(th)) AS n WHERE SOME Card [has CardName: 'Ancestor''s Chosen'] [has CardSetCode: !c] AND d = THE MAXIMUM d2 IN Set has SetCode c2 AND ALSO has SetReleaseDate d2 WHERE SOME Card [has CardName: 'Ancestor''s Chosen'] [has CardSetCode: !c2])
note: latest set containing the card is UMA; '*' power/toughness excluded

answer: LIST n FROM DISTINCT Card [has CardIsPromo: 1] [has CardOtherFaceIds] [has CardOriginalReleaseDate d] has CardName n WHERE starts_with(d, '2019')
note: multi-face = has other face ids; originalReleaseDate is text like 2019/10/6 which year() misreads, so compared by prefix

answer: THE SUM OF m IN Card [has CardArtist: 'Rob Alexander'] [has CardOriginalReleaseDate d] has CardConvertedManaCost m WHERE starts_with(d, '2013')
note: date text like 2013/1/11 which year() misreads, so compared by prefix
